appearance_facts.fact: The May bar is a very short dark-red rectangle whose top sits just above the x-axis baseline, far below the 10,000 kWh gridline and far below every other bar.
May is the shortest bar on the chart; the next shortest (Jun) is roughly at the 17,500–18,000 kWh level, so May is dramatically lower than all other months shown.
